questions.question: Whom does Micah 3 rebuke for hating good and loving evil?
options: The rulers and heads of Israel
The foreign kings of the nations
The merchants and traders of Samaria
The farmers and shepherds of Judah
questions.answer: The rulers and heads of Israel

questions.question: What does Micah 3 say will happen to Zion and Jerusalem because of corrupt leaders?
options: Zion shall flourish and her gates shall never again be shut
Zion shall be spared and her walls shall stand for ever
Zion shall be raised on high and honored among all the nations
Zion shall be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem become a heap of ruins
questions.answer: Zion shall be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem become a heap of ruins
